architecture.A1_context: 文件與單文件歷史；ESS保存、dirty、清空與複合Undo
architecture.A2_hexagonal: UI/Test → Input Tauri commands → DispatchHost → HOST usecase → WORK/domain → output abstractions ← adapters
architecture.A3_dependency: M04 orchestrates its own domain; shared roles coordinated via explicit ports, no UI→adapter bypass
architecture.A7_driving_adapters: Vanilla UI / module tests / Windows native operator
architecture.A8_driven_adapters: Std/FakeFileSystem; any OS/codec/clock capability must be approved, not invented manager
architecture.A9_direction: Domain must not depend on UI/FS/OS/Tauri/concrete adapters
architecture.A10_ownership: 提案WORK持文件revision/compound history，HOST協調；保留selection EditSession原責任。
architecture.A11_mutation: All authoritative mutations through approved input/usecase; projections/codec cannot mutate another document
architecture.A12_transaction: prepare before/after+pins → validate revision → apply one document → append exactly one undo；失敗完整回before不入history。
architecture.A13_external: Untrusted package/media/path inputs; no AI/Git/plugin/startup execution authority
architecture.A14_forbidden: UI→FS/Git/MCP/adapters; Domain→framework; recovery/asset silently changing active content; cross-file merge escape

contract.preconditions: Bound project and correct document/session identity, supported input and approved current revision; proposal details await decisions
contract.success: Result reflects committed version, no error contradiction; design/build status never equals functional acceptance
contract.failure: Refuse/cancel preserves originals; single-document merge rolls back complete before-state; rollback-failure safeguards require D5
contract.ownership: 提案WORK持文件revision/compound history，HOST協調；保留selection EditSession原責任。
contract.atomicity: prepare before/after+pins → validate revision → apply one document → append exactly one undo；失敗完整回before不入history。
contract.lifecycle: Per-open document history; no cross-document or restart Undo; session IDs isolate recovery, not permission to overwrite formal files
invariants: 任一拒絕／取消／失敗不得破壞原有效資料；合併要求回到完整合併前狀態。
文件權威狀態由所屬文件模型持有；UI、序列化、預覽、差異方案及快照均非第二個可任意寫回的SSOT。
合併及Undo的變更集合固定為一份目標文件加必要素材引用；跨文件更動不得隱含加入。
素材被現行文件、其他文件、Undo歷史、進行中交易或保留快照引用時不得物理刪除。此引用根集合為建議架構細化，待G02/G03批准。
快照基準僅在快照與必要素材完整保存並發布索引成功後更新，與正式基準獨立。
成功結果與錯誤結果互斥；NOT RUN、生成完成、預覽可操作與正式功能驗證分開。
確認只作用於已預覽且版本相符的內容；過期方案不得覆寫新資料（版本鎖定為建議契約）。
匯入及預覽不執行包內程式，不洩露憑證，不寫出指定目錄。

findings.observation: 限制scene/與suffix並write_atomic；HOST接受raw text，非完整XML契約驗證
dirty切換兩輪confirm，保存失敗abort；需關閉/退出一致覆蓋
已有volatile清空prepare/confirm/stale guards與單筆Undo/Redo；不含合併/素材/持久快照
scene_save/load直接HOST helper，未走DispatchHost；新架構要明列修補點

inventory.confidence: Presence means source exists only. Gaps are limited to inspected modules and search log; not a whole-repo runtime verdict.

gaps: 文件authority與ESS parser在UI的漸進遷移需批准，不能全面重寫
單文件before/after、素材pin、複合Undo缺同一交易協定
不得以selection edit_undo或UI checkpoint冒充全部文件Undo
extra_obligations: 保存／另存／取代每一步故障、退出的三種選擇、Undo連續操作、關閉重開不保留歷史。
gap.reuse_strategy: Retain existing scoped behavior and add minimum approved delta; do not rebuild historical green capabilities.

current_authorized_writes: own PREP board notes and planning status only
envelope.protected: All other paths. Current authorization excludes ALL product/tests/packaging modifications. No broad production wildcard.
envelope.shared_files: app.js/commands/dispatch/dto/lib are shared composition seams, only named module handlers may change after approval; changes in other modules require that module task.
envelope.new_dependency_cost: No new dependency approved; archive/media/OS lock capability requires explicit pinned choice.
envelope.new_public_api_cost: Proposed role names only; exact DTO/signatures/type count remain pending Skeleton review; this envelope cannot authorize implementation.

cases.title: 保存失敗不離開

cases.when: 在切換專案提示中選保存

cases.then: 文件與內容保持原樣且仍開啟

cases.title: 清空Undo

cases.then: 完整還原內容與引用，只撤回該次操作
cases.valid_red: After approved Skeleton, exact target must compile and reach assertions, failing only for missing target behavior; already present behavior is regression and may pass. No compile/fixture/environment error counts as RED.

cases.title: 合併Undo
cases.given: 單文件合併已成功並含待綁定狀態
cases.then: 還原整次變更及綁定限制，不刪來源或共用素材
cases.valid_red: After approved Skeleton, exact target must compile and reach assertions, failing only for missing target behavior; already present behavior is regression and may pass. No compile/fixture/environment error counts as RED.

cases.title: 關閉及退出
cases.when: 分別選保存/不保存/取消
cases.then: 只在成功保存或明確不保存後離開；失敗保持編輯及原有效檔
cases.valid_red: Test target compiled after approved Skeleton; failure must match missing behavior, not unavailable test target or dependency.

decisions.title: 文件權威與多視窗同步
decisions.observation: UI持archDoc/designDoc；HOST DesignMeta與JS擴充metadata未全對齊；scene command直接HOST helper。
decisions.recommendation: 漸進由WORK持提交內容/revision，Editor留draft；提交經Tauri→DispatchHost→HOST usecase→Ports。先一文件一寫者，其他視窗投影或明確租約；不大搬app.js。
decisions.alternatives: 讓UI繼續唯一authority需明確修改架構規則；立即全面重寫過大，不建議。
decisions.blocking: ownership/mutation/Skeleton門檻；未批准不得靜默搬模型。

decisions.title: 文件Undo與穩定capture
decisions.observation: core EditSession是selection history；UI recovery是volatile清空checkpoint；無素材pin。
decisions.recommendation: 保留selection原契約；WORK加入document before/after revision及compound history，HOST協調pin；M07取stable immutable revision。fingerprint排除selection/viewport/playback及純savedAt。
decisions.alternatives: 擴EditSession管全部文件會混責；只用UI快照無法證明多視窗與素材一致。

decisions.title: 完整回復與並發提交
decisions.recommendation: 先不可變素材＋pins，後單文件commit pointer，保留舊版本；成功才入Undo。正式檔多程序需OS鎖或具體協定拒過期覆寫，不能把Mutex當跨程序鎖。新能力先列精確Port提案；rollback失敗保留復原資料並阻擋破壞性後續。
decisions.alternatives: 依次寫檔best-effort rollback不滿足完整回復；整個DB框架成本高，先不採。
decisions.blocking: transaction未批准，merge/replace/undo/GC不可實作；失敗保證不可自降為warning。
